blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Scientific image segmentation methods rely on extensive annotation and task-specific training, limiting adaptation across imaging modalities and experimental conditions. We present a training-free, one-shot framework that specializes vision foundation models using a single annotated reference image. The framework combines DINOv3 representations with background-adaptive feature orthogonalization to suppress artifact-related feature directions, after which cosine similarity localizes candidate regions for SAM segmentation. We evaluate the framework on red-blood-cell microscopy, structured-illumination pool boiling, and chest radiography. Relative to the strongest baseline, the proposed method improves mean IoU by 5.91 % 5.91\% and 78.62 % 78.62\% on the microscopy and pool-boiling datasets, respectively, while achieving comparable performance on chest radiographs. These results demonstrate that one-shot reference conditioning can adapt general-purpose vision models to specialized scientific segmentation tasks.
blocks.zh: 科学图像分解方法依赖于广泛的注释和针对特定任务的培训,限制了跨成像模式和实验条件的适应. 我们提出了一个无培训的一发一发框架,利用单一附加说明的参考图像,专门制定愿景基础模型。 框架将DINOv3表示法与背景适应特征正交化相结合,以压制与文物相关的特征方向,之后同位素相似性将候选区域定位为SAM分化. 我们评价红血球显微镜 结构化发光池沸腾 以及胸腔辐射图的框架 与最强基线相比,拟议方法在显微镜和花瓶沸腾数据集上分别改进了5.91%的IoU和78.62%的78.62%的IoU,同时在胸腔射线图上取得了可比较的性能. 这些结果表明一发的参考条件可以使通用视觉模型适应专门的科学分解任务.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Generalist-to-specialist one-shot segmentation across scientific imaging domains. A single annotated reference defines each target concept, and the same frozen DINOv3–SAM framework localizes and segments corresponding structures without task-specific training.
blocks.zh: 图1:一般对专家的一发分解,跨越科学成像领域。 单一的附加说明的参考定义了每个目标概念,同一种被冻结的DINOv3-SAM框架将相应的结构本地化并分出部分,而不进行任务特定培训.

blocks.en: Scientific image segmentation enables quantitative analysis in applications such as multiphase flows, blood-cell microscopy, and radiography [ 3 , 5 , 12 ] . Unlike many natural images, scientific images often contain domain-specific structures alongside acquisition-dependent artifacts and background variations, making robust segmentation challenging. Deep-learning-based approaches, including convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and vision transformers (ViTs), have shown success in segmenting scientific images. However, training a supervised model for each experimental setting and segmentation task requires extensive expert annotation.
blocks.zh: 科学的图像分解能够对多相相流、血细胞显微镜和射线摄影等应用进行定量分析[3、5、12]。 与许多自然图像不同的是,科学图像往往包含特定领域的结构以及依赖收购的文物和背景变化,使得强分化具有挑战性. 以深入学习为基础的方法,包括进化神经网络(CNNs)和视觉变压器(ViTs),在将科学图像分解方面显示出了成功. 然而,为每项实验设置和分块任务培训一个监督模型需要广泛的专家说明。

blocks.en: Vision foundation models offer an alternative by transferring representations learned from large-scale pretraining to new tasks without requiring task-specific training. Among these models, self-supervised feature encoders and promptable segmentation models provide complementary capabilities for feature localization and segmentation. Segment Anything (SAM) [ 7 ] generates detailed segmentation masks from spatial prompts, while self-supervised models such as DINOv3 [ 1 , 10 ] provide patch-level representations that support semantic correspondence across images. However, their direct application to scientific images remains unreliable, motivating a generalist-to-specialist framework that adapts to a specific task from one annotated example.
blocks.zh: 愿景基础模式提供了一个替代办法,将从大规模预训中汲取的表述转移到新的任务,而不需要具体任务的培训。 在这些模型中,自我监督的特征编码器和可迅速分解模型为特征定位和分解提供了互补能力. 分段 Anything (SAM) [7] 从空间提示中生成详细的分段口罩,而DINOv3等自控模型[1,10]则提供补丁级的表示,支持跨图像的语义对应. 然而,它们直接应用于科学图象仍然不可靠,它促使一个笼统的对专家的框架适应一个附加说明的例子的具体任务。

blocks.en: Training-free one-shot segmentation transfers target information from a single annotated reference to localize corresponding structures in unlabeled images. Existing approaches include GF-SAM, which uses foreground and background reference features to guide SAM [ 11 ] , and INSID3, which mitigates positional bias in DINOv3 representations through orthogonal feature projection [ 2 ] . However, these approaches do not adapt their feature correction to the background and imaging artifacts observed in the annotated reference.
blocks.zh: 免训练一发分片将目标信息从单一注解的参考文献中转移至无标签图像中的相应结构本地化. 现有方法包括GF-SAM,它使用前景和背景参考特征来指导SAM [11],以及INSID3,它通过正交特征投影来减轻DINov3表达中的位置偏差. [2]. 然而,这些方法并没有使其特征校正适应附加说明的参考文献中所观察到的背景和成像文物。

blocks.en: We address this limitation with a training-free, background-adaptive framework for one-shot scientific-image segmentation, shown in Fig. 1 . Our method uses a single annotated reference image and its corresponding mask to localize target structures and produce fine-grained segmentation masks. We evaluate our framework across pool-boiling imaging, red blood cell microscopy, and chest radiography, representing distinct scientific-imaging modalities and conditions.
blocks.zh: 我们用图1所示的一弹一弹科学图像分解的无培训、背景适应框架来处理这一限制。 我们的方法使用单一注解的参考图像及其相应的口罩来将目标结构本地化并产生精细的分解口罩. 我们评价我们的框架,包括花瓶沸腾的成像、红血球显微镜和胸腔射线照相,代表着不同的科学成像模式和条件。

blocks.en: Our main contributions in this paper are as follows: • We present a training-free, one-shot framework that adapts frozen foundation vision models to scientific images using only a single annotated reference. • We introduce a background-adaptive orthogonal projection that uses the annotated reference background to suppress background structures and imaging artifacts. • We evaluate the framework across three scientific datasets, demonstrating its applicability to distinct structures, artifacts, and modalities.
blocks.zh: 我们在本文件中的主要贡献如下: 我们提出了一个无培训的一弹一弹框架,只使用一个附加说明的参考文献,使被冻结的基础愿景模型适应科学图像。 我们采用一种背景适应正交投影法,利用附加说明的参考背景来压制背景结构和成像文物。 我们评估了三个科学数据集的框架,显示了其对不同结构、文物和模式的适用性。

blocks.en: We present a training-free, one-shot framework that adapts frozen foundation vision models to scientific images using only a single annotated reference.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一个无培训、一弹即发的框架,这个框架只使用一个附加说明的参考资料,使被冻结的基础远景模型适应科学图像。

blocks.en: We introduce a background-adaptive orthogonal projection that uses the annotated reference background to suppress background structures and imaging artifacts.
blocks.zh: 我们采用了一种背景适应正交投影法,利用附加说明的参考背景压制背景结构和成像文物。

blocks.en: We evaluate the framework across three scientific datasets, demonstrating its applicability to distinct structures, artifacts, and modalities.
blocks.zh: 我们评估了三个科学数据集的框架,显示了其对不同结构、文物和模式的适用性。

blocks.en: 2 Methodology
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: Figure 2 : End-to-end one-shot segmentation framework. DINOv3 features from the target image are compared with a foreground prototype obtained from the annotated reference. The resulting similarity map is thresholded to localize candidate regions. A distance transform identifies interior point prompts, while connected regions provide bounding-box prompts for SAM2, which produces the final segmentation masks.
blocks.zh: 图2 :一发一发相接相接框架. 来自目标图像的DINOv3特性被与从注释参考获得的展望原型相提并论. 由此产生的相似性地图是将候选区域本地化的门槛。 相距变换可以识别出内部点提示,而相接区域则为SAM2提供边框提示,产生出最终分解口罩.

blocks.en: The proposed framework combines the semantic representations of DINOv3 with the prompt-based segmentation capabilities of SAM. A single annotated reference example, consisting of an image and its corresponding mask, defines the target structures to be localized in subsequent target images. This formulation enables adaptation to a specific segmentation objective without additional training. A qualitative visualization of the complete framework, including feature matching, candidate-region localization, prompt generation, and final segmentation, is shown in Fig. 2 .
blocks.zh: 拟议框架将DINOv3的语义表述与SAM的即时分化能力结合起来. 一个由图像及其相应的口罩组成的单一附加说明的参考实例,定义了在后续的目标图像中要本地化的目标结构. 这种提法使得能够在没有额外培训的情况下适应具体的分化目标。 图2显示了整个框架的定性可视化,包括特征匹配、候选区域本地化、迅速生成和最终分解。

blocks.en: 2.1 Feature Extraction with DINOv3
blocks.zh: 2.1 与DINOv3的地物提取

blocks.en: The proposed method first passes the annotated reference frame and subsequent target frames through a frozen pretrained DINOv3 model [ 10 ] . DINOv3 is well suited to this setting because its self-supervised training produces patch-level representations which are able to group semantically similar regions without predefined class labels. For each image, we extract the normalized patch tokens from the final attention layer, giving us the feature vector 𝐅 ∈ ℝ H ′ × W ′ × D \mathbf{F}\in\mathbb{R}^{H^{\prime}\times W^{\prime}\times D} , where D is the embedding dimension and H ′ H^{\prime} and W ′ W^{\prime} are the dimensions of the patch-wise grid produced by the ViT. The annotated reference image can therefore define a new target class from its feature representation.
blocks.zh: 拟议方法首先通过一个被冻结的预先训练的DINOv3型号[10]通过附加说明的参考框架和随后的目标框架. DINOv3非常适合这种设置,因为其自我监督的训练产生补丁级的表示,能够在没有预定义的类标签的情况下将类似区域分组. 对于每个图像,我们从最后的注意层中提取出归一化的补丁符号,给我们一个特性向量F QQ R H → × W → D mathbf{F}\in\ mathbb{R}^{H^{\prime}\tims W^{\prime}\times D},其中D是嵌入维度,而H'H^{\prime}和W'W^{\prime}是由ViT所出取的修补网格的维度. 因此,附加说明的参考图像可以从其特征表示定义一个新的目标类.

blocks.en: 2.2 Background-Adaptive Feature Orthogonalization
blocks.zh: 2.2 背景地貌化

blocks.en: Scientific images can contain acquisition-specific artifacts, including glare, occluded objects, and motion blur in the raw image. During post-processing, these artifacts may not be removed completely. To reduce the effects of these components in the segmentation process, we employ a latent-space orthogonal projection. The reference mask is downsampled to match the spatial dimensions of the DINOv3 patch grid. The resulting Boolean mask partitions the reference tokens into foreground and background sets, with the selected foreground tokens forming the feature set 𝐅 ref \mathbf{F}_{\mathrm{ref}} .
blocks.zh: 科学图像可以包含获取特定的文物,包括光泽,被被吞噬的物体,以及原始图像中运动模糊. 在后处理期间,这些文物可能不会被完全取出. 为了减少这些组件在分解过程中的影响,我们采用了潜在的正交投影. 参考口罩被下取样来与DINOv3补丁网格的空间尺寸相匹配. 由此产生的布尔掩码将参考符分割成前方和后方组合,选定的前方标识符组成了功能设置F ref\mathbf{F}_{\-mathrm{ref}}.

blocks.en: 2.3 Localization, Prompt Generation, and Segmentation
blocks.zh: 2.3 本地化、即时生成和分化

blocks.en: To localize candidate target regions, we compute cosine similarity between the projected reference prototype 𝐩 \mathbf{p} and every projected target token in 𝐅 out \mathbf{F}_{\mathrm{out}} . The resulting scores are reshaped into a two-dimensional similarity map and thresholded to produce a binary candidate map. Because patch-level similarity can create small gaps within otherwise coherent regions, a morphological hole-filling operation is applied to consolidate the detected structures. A Euclidean distance transform then assigns each foreground pixel its distance to the nearest background pixel. Local maxima of the distance map provide interior point prompts, while the enclosing bounds of each connected region provide bounding-box prompts. These prompts are supplied to SAM, which produces a fine-grained segmentation mask for the target structures represented by the annotated reference.
blocks.zh: 为了将候选目标区域本地化,我们计算出预测参考原型p\ mathbf{p}和F出\mathbf{F}_{\ mathrm{out}中每个预测目标符号之间的同心相似性。 由此产生的分数被重塑为一幅二维相似度图并设定出阈值来制作二进制候选地图. 由于补丁级相似性可以在原本相通的区域内产生出小的缺口,因此采用了形态填孔操作来巩固被检测出的结构. 一个欧几利得距离变换,然后将每个前地像素的距离分配到最接近的背景像素. 距离图的局部最大值提供内部点提示,而每个相接区域的附加边框提供边框提示. 这些提示是提供给SAM的,它为附加说明的引用所代表的目标结构生产出精细的分解口罩.

blocks.en: 3 Results
blocks.zh: 3 结果

blocks.en: Table 1 : One-shot segmentation performance across scientific imaging domains. Best results are shown in bold and second-best results are underlined.
blocks.zh: 表1:科学成像领域的一发分片性能。 最佳成果以粗体表示,并着重说明次好的成果。

blocks.en: We evaluate the proposed method across red-blood-cell microscopy, structured-illumination pool boiling, and chest radiography. These datasets represent distinct imaging modalities, target structures, and background characteristics, allowing us to assess the adaptability of the same framework under different scientific imaging conditions.
blocks.zh: 我们通过红血球显微镜 结构化光电池沸腾 以及胸腔射线摄影 来评估拟议方法 这些数据集代表了不同的成像模式,目标结构和背景特征,使我们能够评估同一框架在不同科学成像条件下的适应性.

blocks.en: 3.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集

blocks.en: Red Blood Cell Microscopy. We first use the 100k-RBC-PathOlOgics dataset [ 4 ] , which contains 240,790 segmented RBC images across nine classes with varying cell structures. We use a separate annotated reference for each class to assess the framework’s ability to localize and delineate small targets with subtle class-specific differences.
blocks.zh: 红血细胞显微镜. 我们首先使用100k-RBC-PathOlOgics数据集[4],其中包含由不同细胞结构组成的9个类的240,790个分块RBC图像. 我们用一个单独的附加说明的参考材料来评估框架在细微的类别差异下将小目标本地化和划定的能力。

blocks.en: Structured Illumination Pool Boiling. We evaluate 20 pool-boiling frames recorded using structured illumination (SI) and reconstructed for optical sectioning. Two different reconstruction methods are evaluated: the Sequence Hilbert Transform (SHT) reconstruction [ 13 ] and the root-mean-square (RMS) reconstruction [ 8 , 9 ] . Residual illumination patterns, spatially varying contrast, and closely spaced features make accurate foreground localization particularly challenging. For each reconstruction method, the reconstructed frames serve as target images for segmentation.
blocks.zh: 结构化照明池沸腾. 我们用结构化照明(SI)来评估20个被记录的池沸相框,并重建用于光学分层. 评价了两种不同的重建方法:序列希尔伯特变形(SHT)重建[13]和根-正-平方(RMS)重建[8,9]. 残余的发光模式、空间相差悬殊的对比和紧密的空间特征使得准确的前地定位尤其具有挑战性。 对于每一种重建方法,被重建的框架都作为分块的目标图像.

blocks.en: Chest Radiography. Finally, we evaluate one-shot segmentation on the Montgomery County chest X-ray dataset [ 6 ] , which contains 138 frontal radiographs with corresponding lung masks, including 58 tuberculosis-positive cases. This dataset tests adaptation to projection images with overlapping anatomy and low-contrast boundaries.
blocks.zh: 胸电图. 最后,我们评价蒙哥马利县胸X射线数据集上的一发分片,该数据集包含138个正面放射图并有相应的肺口罩,包括58个结核病阳性病例. 这个数据集测试了对具有重叠解剖学和低相接边界的投影图像的适应性.

blocks.en: 3.2 Segmentation Results
blocks.zh: 3.2 分区结果

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Qualitative segmentation comparison on structured-illumination pool-boiling data. The proposed method recovers more of the required annotated features than SAM2 and GF-SAM while accurately reducing the enlarged and merged regions produced by INSID3.
blocks.zh: 图3:结构-照明池-沸腾数据定性分解比较. 拟议方法回收了比SAM2和GF-SAM更多的需要附加说明的特性,同时准确地减少了INSID3产生的扩大和合并区域.

blocks.en: We evaluate segmentation performance using mean intersection over union (IoU) and Dice score. Table 1 compares the proposed method with SAM2, GF-SAM, and INSID3. On RBC microscopy, the proposed method exceeds GF-SAM, the strongest baseline, by 5.15 percentage points in mean IoU and 2.94 percentage points in Dice. The largest gains occur on pool-boiling images, where the proposed method exceeds INSID3 by 33.36 percentage points in mean IoU and 26.62 percentage points in Dice. On chest radiography, the proposed method achieves performance comparable to SAM2. Fig. 3 shows that SAM2 and GF-SAM recover only a subset of the bubbles in the pool-boiling target image, while INSID3 produces enlarged and merged masks. The proposed method recovers more instances while better preserving their shapes and boundaries. These results indicate that background-adaptive feature processing is particularly effective when scientific imaging artifacts dominate the learned feature representations.
blocks.zh: 我们用平均相接点来评估分化性能。 表1将拟议方法与SAM2、GF-SAM和INSID3进行了比较。 在RBC显微镜方面,拟议方法超过了GF-SAM这一最强基线,平均IoU比5.15个百分点,Dice比2.94个百分点。 最大的收益来自沸腾相片,其中拟议方法在IoU和Dice中分别比INSID3高出33.36个百分点和26.62个百分点。 在胸射线学方面,拟议方法的性能与SAM2相当. 图3显示,SAM2和GF-SAM只回收了池沸目标图像中的一个子集,而INSID3则生产了扩大和合并的口罩. 拟议方法回收更多实例,同时更好地保留其形状和界限。 这些结果表明,当科学成像文物主导所学地物表现时,背景适应地物处理特别有效.

blocks.zh: 图4:背景适应性特征正交化对RMS重建的池沸框架的影响。 与未预测的DINOv3特性和高斯噪声投影相比,所拟议的方法在保留目标-泡泡活化的同时会压制背景响应.

blocks.en: Background-adaptive feature orthogonalization substantially suppresses residual background activation in the cosine-similarity map. As shown in Fig. 4 , the unprojected DINOv3 features and the Gaussian-noise projection used by INSID3 [ 2 ] retain elevated responses across the structured background. The proposed method reduces these responses to near zero while preserving strong, localized activation over the target bubbles. Across 20 pool-boiling frames, mean background similarity decreases from 0.3117 0.3117 for the unprojected features and 0.2847 0.2847 for the Gaussian-noise projection to − 0.0020 -0.0020 with the proposed method. The contrast-to-noise ratio correspondingly increases from 2.74 2.74 and 2.64 2.64 to 2.97 2.97 . These results indicate that a background direction estimated from the annotated reference provides stronger feature-space separation than a generic Gaussian-noise reference.

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en: While scientific image segmentation is essential for quantitative analysis, existing approaches often require extensive expert annotation or perform unreliably under specialized imaging conditions. To address these limitations, we present a training-free, one-shot framework that adapts frozen vision foundation models for scientific image segmentation. Experiments on red blood cell microscopy, structured-illumination pool boiling, and chest radiography demonstrate the adaptability of the framework to distinct imaging modalities. On pool-boiling data, the proposed method exceeds the strongest baseline by 33.36 percentage points in mean IoU while substantially suppressing background responses in feature space. By reducing reliance on large, expert-annotated datasets, this background-adaptive framework can make specialized segmentation more accessible across scientific imaging domains.
blocks.zh: 虽然科学图像分解对于定量分析至关重要,但现有方法往往需要广泛的专家说明或在专门成像条件下进行不可靠的工作。 为了克服这些局限性,我们提出了一个免费的一发一发的框架,以适应科学图像分解的冷冻视觉基础模型。 红血球显微镜的实验,结构化-发光池沸腾,胸射线的实验展示了框架对不同成像模式的适应性. 在跳池数据方面,拟议方法在平均IoU中超过最强基线33.36个百分点,同时在特征空间实质上压制背景反应。 通过减少对大型、专家说明的数据集的依赖,这种背景适应框架可以使专门的分块在科学成像领域更容易获得。
